# thedroppic

> thedroppic is a set of free image converters that run in the visitor's web browser: JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC. Images are processed on the visitor's device and are not uploaded to a server. No account is required.

## Converters

- [JPEG to PNG](https://thedroppic.com/jpeg-to-png): Save JPEG files as lossless PNG. Up to 5 images at once.
- [PNG to JPEG](https://thedroppic.com/png-to-jpeg): Turn PNG files into smaller JPEGs with an adjustable quality. Transparent areas become white.
- [HEIC to JPEG](https://thedroppic.com/heic-to-jpeg): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPEG so they open anywhere.
- [WebP to JPEG](https://thedroppic.com/webp-to-jpeg): Convert WebP images to JPEG so they open anywhere.
- [WebP to PNG](https://thedroppic.com/webp-to-png): Convert WebP images to PNG and keep transparency.
- [JPEG to WebP](https://thedroppic.com/jpeg-to-webp): Make lighter web images from JPEG with an adjustable quality.
- [PNG to WebP](https://thedroppic.com/png-to-webp): Make smaller files from PNG with an adjustable quality.

## Guides and information

- [How it works](https://thedroppic.com/how-it-works): The three steps (drop, convert, download) and why nothing is uploaded.
- [Blog](https://thedroppic.com/blog): All guides.
- [Which image format to use](https://thedroppic.com/blog/best-image-format): A guide to choosing between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF and HEIC.
- [How browser-based image processing works](https://thedroppic.com/blog/browser-based-image-processing): What happens to an image when it is processed in the browser instead of on a server.
- [About thedroppic](https://thedroppic.com/about): What the site does and how it protects privacy.

## Privacy model

- Conversion runs in the browser using WebAssembly. Images are not sent to a server.
- No account is needed. The site does not use analytics or advertising scripts.

## Supported formats and limits

- Each converter accepts only its own source format: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC (and HEIF).
- Up to 5 images per batch. Images over roughly 100 megapixels are rejected.
